_doc: tools/import_frames.gd: Tanko's in-match side view from the AI-made run cycle (frame_1..8.png, 1280x720, facing right) and the ready pose (poses.ready: ../side_ready/ready_v1.png, 1024x765, kneeling, hugging the gun). Source px unless noted. height: the run frames at Rookie's source px per world px (the heads drawn the same size: 58.08 = 60 x his figure 515 / Rookie's 532 source px; a little shorter, broader); idle: the standing picture ../side_idle/idle_v1.png (poses.stand; without it frame_7, index 6, the most upright run frame); walk 15 fps: the planted foot moves back ~6 world px a frame (Rookie ~4.7 at 20 fps), 90 px/s walk. See assets/README.md.

idle._doc: the standing picture (poses.stand); without it the run frame 6 (frame_7.png)

draw._doc: the ready pose, shown at once while the gun is out (gunDraw: no transition)

fire._doc: the shot from the ready pose: its frame with the recoil (the hugged gun kicks back along its axis by the flash)

gun._doc: angle per frame is added to the hold (+ = muzzle down). The gun is holstered in idle / walk in the match; carry: where it would be held (px from the feet pivot, source px). fists (optional, Rookie's config): the near fist per source frame, to sway the gun with the arm.

gunDraw._doc: gun_draw.gd TIMINGS overrides: the ready pose switches in and out at once

stand._doc: pose px (1280x720): standing upright, facing right, transparent background (cleaned like the run frames). scale: source px per pose px (the helmet as wide as in the run frames); alignX: the ear on frame_7's, shifted into frame_1's place by the stabilise offset (the head does not jump idle <-> walk <-> ready); the soles on the soles' row.

ready._doc: pose px (1024x765): kneeling, facing right, both fists together on the chest, NO gun, on a flat green backdrop (keyed out: `background`, holeMin / holePure / spillFrom keyed as Flora's; the AI sparkle bottom right goes with the detached pieces, keepPieces). scale: source px per pose px (the helmet as wide and as tall as in the run frames); alignX: the ear on frame_7's (the old idle frame, shifted into frame_1's place by the stabilise offset). The hug gun is placed in `scene` (its GunSocket on the fists: the gun turns round it).

gun._doc: the fallback seat (no scene): the hug point, the middle of the two fists (pose px), level

armFront._doc: the near arm drawn OVER the hugged gun (assets/characters/tanko/side/ready_arm_front.png, same canvas as ready_0), pose px: polygon round the near shoulder pad, the sleeve, the forearm and both fists (not the grenades above); seeds: one point inside each piece the outline walls in (the far forearm right of the fists stays under the gun). See Rookie's config for the keys.
